policy_name: Pinnacle Care Alliance RP-114: Arthroscopic Knee Procedures (illustrative)

criteria.criterion: 4.1 - Synovectomy performed in compartment(s) separate from the meniscectomy compartment
criteria.evidence: Meniscectomy in the medial compartment; synovectomy in the suprapatellar pouch, patellofemoral compartment and lateral gutter; no medial synovectomy.

citation.excerpt: No synovectomy was performed in the medial compartment.

criteria.criterion: 4.2 - Operative report specifically documents the separate compartments treated
criteria.evidence: The procedure list and description name each compartment, a separate superolateral portal, and about 25 minutes of added operative time.

citation.excerpt: Right knee arthroscopic major synovectomy of the lateral compartment/lateral gutter, suprapatellar pouch and patellofemoral compartment.

criteria.criterion: 4.3 - Line billed with modifier XS (or 59) plus laterality
criteria.evidence: Line 2 was billed as 29876-RT without XS/59.

citation.excerpt: Coder note: No distinct-procedure modifier was appended to line 2 at original submission.

criteria.action_needed: Correct line 2 to 29876-XS-RT on a corrected claim.

criteria.criterion: Section 5 - Corrected claim or appeal within 90 days of the remittance
criteria.evidence: The remittance is dated {{DENIAL_DATE}}; the correction is within the window.

citation.excerpt: Submit a corrected claim or a written appeal with the operative report within 90 days of this remittance.

criteria.evidence: The MRI showed marked synovial thickening, and pathology confirmed chronic proliferative synovitis.

citation.excerpt: chronic proliferative synovitis with villous hyperplasia.

overall_assessment: The documentation fully satisfies RP-114 Section 4; only the modifier was missing. A corrected claim with XS should resolve the denial.
